label: Death of Queen Victoria after eclipse hits

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says the visible May 28, 1900 solar eclipse fell on Queen Victoria's Ascendant and luminaries, and the Queen died on January 22, 1901.

label: Death of Prince Albert after eclipse to progressed factors

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says the July 8, 1861 solar eclipse was one degree from Prince Albert's progressed Mars and square his progressed Sun before his death on December 14, 1861.

label: Edward VII coronation crisis and operation

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says a May 7, 1902 eclipse opposed King Edward VII's Sun and the April 22, 1902 lunar eclipse fell on his Midheaven before the June 24 appendicitis operation and coronation postponement.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says the December 30, 1907 Saturn-Mars conjunction in Pisces, the ruling sign of Portugal, was followed on February 1, 1908 by the murder of the King and Crown Prince of Portugal.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says Saturn-Mars conjunctions produce war, rioting, murder, and danger to the kings and governments of the countries ruled by the sign in which the conjunction falls.

source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says Roosevelt was inaugurated on retrograde Mars and during his administration an assassin attempted to shoot him, a foreign power attacked American territory, and he died in office.

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green treats the 1910 death of Edward VII as an example of ingress and lunation testimony manifesting in royal affairs.

label: Hitler accession with retrograde Mars background

source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says Mars was retrograde from January 21 to April 12, 1933, that Hitler came to power on January 30, and that he eventually was defeated on all fronts and died in the holocaust.
